m3_candidate_use: Research-only comparison lead for semantic/translation crosswalk design; not a general distributable M3 lexicon payload
admission_blockers: Do not bundle or redistribute the graph for general M3 use absent applicable permission; review the full version-specific license and component rights

data_shape_and_identity: wikidata_id (QID), eng, label, language, type (PER/LOC/ORG); Hugging Face card reports 140M rows and 485 language values; paper describes 400+ languages; a row label is not a lexeme identity
rights_and_attribution: Conflicting license evidence: Hugging Face card labels the dataset MIT while the 2024 paper says CC BY 4.0; retain both claims and Wikidata attribution; no blanket rights conclusion
m3_candidate_use: Exact name/alias lookup and entity linking keyed by Wikidata entity ID plus source language; preserve script/language tags and keep proper-name identity distinct from lexeme identity
admission_blockers: Resolve license metadata with maintainers; pin exact dataset snapshot and file hash; audit duplicate QID/language/type row keys and reject collisions; preserve the source QID; no payload admitted

data_shape_and_identity: Per-language repositories with lexicon/morphology sources, lexc/twolc finite-state transducers, analyzers/generators, constraint grammar and proofing resources; schemas and varieties are language-specific
rights_and_attribution: License is per repository and may separately cover code and data; for example lang-rus states GPL-3.0; inspect each language package and retain attribution/community conditions
m3_candidate_use: Evaluate compact language-specific morphology and analyzer precomputes for underserved languages; preserve repository, variety, script and native lexical identities
admission_blockers: Pin repository and commit per language; audit exact data/code licenses and community protocols; qualify analyzer/generator behavior against source fixtures; no universal GiellaLT license assumed

data_shape_and_identity: Shared abstract syntax with language-specific concrete grammars and paradigms; project reports grammar support for 40+ languages; not a flat word-list format
rights_and_attribution: Review compiler, runtime, grammar-library and language-resource license surfaces independently; do not infer one license for all modules or data
m3_candidate_use: Evaluate grammar/paradigm composition and reusable language-specific generation rules alongside M3 lexical atoms
admission_blockers: Pin GF core, RGL and language-module revisions; prove per-language parse/generate behavior and platform/runtime fit; inspect exact module rights before adaptation

data_shape_and_identity: Task-specific multilingual morpheme-segmentation fixtures combining resources such as UniMorph, MorphyNet, UD and Wiktionary; evaluation labels are not canonical lexeme/sense IDs
rights_and_attribution: Task repository states CC BY-SA 3.0 inherited from Wiktionary; preserve attribution and the exact task/data release
m3_candidate_use: Use as a regression/differential fixture for language-specific atomization, segmentation and morphology precomputes; do not treat it as production dictionary authority
admission_blockers: Pin task/data release and source splits; inspect component provenance and label semantics; test-only until redistribution rights are approved

data_shape_and_identity: JSON package reports 7,130 integrated records keyed by ISO 639-3; combines Glottolog identity/geography, WALS features, and demographic/endangerment fields; not a lexical dictionary and no per-record stable M3 identity is claimed
rights_and_attribution: Dataset card declares CC BY 4.0; retain attribution and verify the exact Zenodo release and upstream source conditions independently
m3_candidate_use: Reference-only language crosswalk metadata for language-aware lexicon routing and shard selection; do not intern display names or demographic labels as language IDs
admission_blockers: Pin full HF commit and artifact digest before admission; ISO 639-3 alone can merge varieties/macrolanguages and is not a unique M3 language-variety key; preserve Glottocode separately and reject ambiguous mappings

data_shape_and_identity: Over 40 languages; small/large lists use Zipf frequency bins rounded to 0.01 with per-language normalization/tokenization; upstream describes the corpus snapshot as usage through about 2021; no universal lexeme IDs
rights_and_attribution: Library code is Apache-2.0, but bundled frequency data is CC BY-SA 4.0 and has source-specific attribution conditions; keep code and data notices separate
m3_candidate_use: Evaluate as a frozen offline frequency prior and lookup seed; frequency remains corpus evidence separate from lexeme identity and translation links
admission_blockers: Do not export a bare CSV: upstream says a CSV without attribution/license context does not comply; retain notices and source credits, pin the data package, and treat the 2021 snapshot as stale for current-frequency claims

resource: RefLex CLLD Reference Lexicon of Africa v1.0 (2025; DOI 10.34847/nkl.e3cbkjzm)
data_shape_and_identity: The CLLD release reports 1,435 lexical sources, 927,845 lexical records and 815 distinct languoids; it exposes original lexical forms and downloadable data, while the larger original database has separate functionality
rights_and_attribution: CC BY-NC-SA 4.0; retain citation to Segerer et al. 2025 and the exact CLLD release
m3_candidate_use: Research-only discovery and evaluation for African-language lexeme coverage, source-linked lexical lookup and languoid-aware shard planning
admission_blockers: Noncommercial/share-alike terms preclude general commercial bundling without a compatible grant; pin downloadable artifact and schema; audit record/source IDs, variety mapping and source-level provenance before any admission

data_shape_and_identity: Current overview reports 1,214 corpora, 1,038 languages and 102,878,590,853 sentence pairs; each corpus/version has its own files, pair coverage, source coordinates and documentation
rights_and_attribution: Heterogeneous corpus-specific terms and citations; the OPUS collection is not one blanket license
m3_candidate_use: Discover translation bitext, language-pair coverage and candidate phrase/frequency evidence; retain corpus-level source records and IDs
admission_blockers: Do not ingest from aggregate counts; audit each corpus/release license, source, privacy, alignment, duplicate and quality policy; pin metadata snapshot and exact corpus version; phrase statistics are not lexeme identity

resource: Google FLEURS (Hugging Face card revision b4a42ed06e12025c42f3b4eff6338ace2fe2447a)
data_shape_and_identity: 102-language speech benchmark; audio is paired with raw/normalized transcription and dataset-local id/lang_id; 2,009 n-way parallel sentences are drawn from FLoRes dev/devtest
rights_and_attribution: HF card declares CC BY 4.0; preserve Google/FLEURS attribution and separately review the underlying FLoRes text provenance and any asset-specific conditions
m3_candidate_use: Cross-script transcription, speech/orthography tests, language identification and parallel phrase alignment fixtures; not a dictionary or canonical translation source
admission_blockers: Pin files and hashes per split/config; retain language/locale and sample IDs without promoting them to M3 lexeme IDs; verify underlying sentence rights, speaker/privacy terms and normalization behavior before admission

resource: Google WAXAL NLP multilingual African speech corpus (Hugging Face card observed 2026-10-19)
data_shape_and_identity: Audio/text Parquet resource for ASR and TTS across African languages; current Hub page reports 821 GB and exposes language facets; card metadata declares two license identifiers
rights_and_attribution: The Hub card simultaneously lists CC BY-SA 4.0 and CC BY 4.0; the research paper describes CC BY 4.0; treat this as unresolved artifact-level rights evidence
m3_candidate_use: Discover underrepresented-language transcriptions, pronunciation and language/script coverage; do not flatten speech rows into lexical identities
admission_blockers: Resolve contradictory license metadata for exact files/configs; pin immutable revision, hashes and data-card history; verify speaker consent, community terms, language variety and attribution before reuse; no full-corpus download

data_shape_and_identity: Dictionary releases are downloadable as CLDF; entry, sense and example IDs are dictionary-scoped; examples, references and media vary by project; use dictionary DOI/repository plus native entry/sense IDs as source identity.
rights_and_attribution: Dictionaria states CC BY 4.0 for site content; audit each DOI artifact and source/community terms separately; preserve author/community attribution; code and data rights are distinct.
m3_candidate_use: Reference source-linked low-resource lexicons, senses, examples and morphology where supplied; map source-native dictionary IDs without equating glosses with universal lexeme IDs.
admission_blockers: No single cross-dictionary ID namespace; pin each DOI/artifact and hash; review source variety, consent, item rights, missingness and CLDF schema before any admission; no payload admitted.

data_shape_and_identity: Archive handle 20.500.12185/321 covers source/genre-classified documents, raw/clean corpus, lexicon, frequency list and named-entity lists; SADiLaR portal reports 1,965,473 words for the isiZulu text corpus; lexical row IDs are not established.
rights_and_attribution: The exact isiZulu archive item declares CC BY 2.5 South Africa; retain Eiselen & Puttkammer citation and repository handle; other NCHLT items have separate records and licenses.
m3_candidate_use: Candidate isiZulu lexicon, corpus-specific frequencies and name lists; useful source-scoped precompute and differential fixtures, not canonical universal vocabulary.
admission_blockers: Pin each artifact file and checksum; audit row format, tokenizer/count semantics, language variety and source IDs; do not extend this item's license to other NCHLT artifacts; no admission yet.

resource: South American Indigenous Language Structures (SAILS) Online
data_shape_and_identity: CLLD database is split into non-uniform domains with feature/value, language variety and bibliography/source records; preserve domain + native language + feature + source coordinates and multi-valued construction structures.
rights_and_attribution: Site declares CC BY-NC-ND 2.0 Germany; attribute the full SAILS citation; noncommercial/no-derivatives terms block general commercial adaptation or redistribution.
m3_candidate_use: Reference-only grammar coverage and test design for sparse, source-backed typological feature lookups across underdocumented South American languages.
admission_blockers: Domains differ in coverage/schema and the site provides no immutable release hash in this pass; preserve unknown versus absent and domain-specific values; no adaptation or payload admission under current rights.

data_shape_and_identity: 3,564 directed language pairs across 62 languages; up to ten corpus-derived target-word candidates per source token, with direction and rank; no concept/sense identity; source is OpenSubtitles2018.
rights_and_attribution: Repository code is Apache-2.0; no separate license for the generated dictionary payload is established in the repo; OpenSubtitles2018 source-corpus rights and attribution govern and require exact review; cite Choe et al. and Lison et al.
m3_candidate_use: Candidate ranked-translation baseline and regression/evaluation fixture for M3 translation mapping; scores are corpus association, not proof of exact translation or synonymy.
admission_blockers: Pin exact pair files and hashes; verify data and source-corpus permissions; preserve pair direction, tokenization, rank and corpus provenance; no payload or dictionary semantics admitted.

resource: WordHoard multilingual frequency and inflection dictionary
data_shape_and_identity: Build currently documents de/fr/es/it/en entries keyed by language + lemma + POS, plus surface/inflection forms, corpus count/rank, gender and CEFR estimate; output data has source provenance but not universal lexeme IDs.
rights_and_attribution: Code is MIT; built dataset is CC BY-SA 4.0 because of Wiktionary-derived morphology/gender; OpenSubtitles frequency source is separately MIT; retain NOTICE/attribution and audit source-specific terms; Goethe CEFR lists are calibration-only and not redistributed.
m3_candidate_use: Useful reference for a compact compositional frequency+morphology precompute schema and language-specific coverage tests; no donor dataset copied.
admission_blockers: Only five implemented languages in the current README; CEFR values include estimates; pin source and release artifacts, preserve per-layer provenance and share-alike terms; not eligible for unrestricted data bundling.

resource: Facebook Research MUSE ground-truth bilingual dictionary benchmark
data_shape_and_identity: Repository reports 110 directed bilingual dictionaries with train/test splits (5,000/1,500 unique source words) and some larger sets up to 100,000 pairs; preserve pair direction and split; no sense IDs.
rights_and_attribution: Repository LICENSE is CC BY-NC 4.0; retain attribution and verify each dictionary artifact's own provenance; repo is archived read-only since 2023; noncommercial restriction prevents general product bundling.
m3_candidate_use: Use only as a research-only differential benchmark for candidate translation ranking, precision@k and language-pair coverage; never as an identity or production-translation authority.
admission_blockers: Pin the archived revision and exact dictionary files; audit source-language normalization and split leakage; noncommercial rights are incompatible with general commercial payload distribution; no admission.

resource: Numeral Systems of the World's Languages (Chan 2019, CLDF extraction)
data_shape_and_identity: CLDF Form rows link source Form IDs to Language_ID and Parameter_ID; source snapshot accessed 2019-09-30; 5,332 varieties, 100 concepts, 187,742 lexemes; some language links need Glottolog correction
rights_and_attribution: Repository declares CC BY 4.0; cite Chan's 2019 source and the derived CLDF release; preserve attribution and dated snapshot
m3_candidate_use: Cross-linguistic number-form lookup and language-specific numeral composition evidence
admission_blockers: Only 100 concepts, not a complete number-word inventory for 0-10,000; retain native Form/Language/Parameter IDs and source citation; validate language-variety links; never synthesize unseen forms

data_shape_and_identity: CLDF forms preserve Form ID, Language_ID, Parameter_ID, NumberValue, segmentation and morpheme fields; sample includes explicit decomposition such as thirty-five
rights_and_attribution: Repository states CC BY 4.0; cite the versioned dataset DOI and 2025 SIGTYP v1 paper; associated 2026 manuscript for v2 is marked under review
m3_candidate_use: Test evidence for precomputing numeral morpheme/decomposition signals by language and number value
admission_blockers: Not a general number generator and not a complete 0-10,000 coverage proof; preserve source IDs, known/unknown annotations and language variety; require per-language differential tests before any rule is inferred

data_shape_and_identity: 21 Indic languages across 12 scripts; about 26M native/English word pairs; language-pair train/validation/test JSONL with record ID, native word, English word, source and optional score
rights_and_attribution: Upstream distinguishes manually collected CC BY data, mined Samanantar/IndicCorp CC0 data, and existing-source CC0 data; HF's generic cc tag is not sufficient for row-level admission
m3_candidate_use: Roman/native-script lookup and transliteration candidate evaluation; distinct from translation or concept identity
admission_blockers: Do not assign one blanket license; preserve native record ID, pair direction, script, source, score and split; audit each source-specific row and pin the dataset revision

data_shape_and_identity: 49.6M English-to-Indic sentence pairs across 11 Indic languages plus Indic-Indic pairs; public release is shuffled, untokenized and deduplicated; source files are grouped as existing or created and by source
rights_and_attribution: Samanantar download page does not establish one uniform license for every underlying corpus; CC0 statements for other BPCC/IndicTrans2 components do not automatically license these files
m3_candidate_use: Indic translation candidate mining, sentence alignment fixtures and language-pair coverage
admission_blockers: No guaranteed durable pair ID is shown; retain exact package/revision/source split/file digest/physical coordinate; review every underlying source and don't treat sentence alignment as dictionary equivalence

data_shape_and_identity: ACL 2023 release reports 20.9B tokens across 24 languages; Hugging Face artifact is a large text corpus with language subsets and no word-level lexeme IDs; suitable only as a versioned input to deterministic recounting
rights_and_attribution: HF card states the created datasets are CC0 and code/models MIT; source page says AI4Bharat does not own all source text, so review content/source terms and attribution separately
m3_candidate_use: Recompute language/corpus/tokenizer-scoped frequency tables and validate existing frequency precomputes
admission_blockers: Do not equate this corpus with its predecessor or an existing frequency list; pin exact revision and subset, retain tokenizer/normalization provenance, audit source rights; no bulk payload admission in this catalogue task

data_shape_and_identity: 11 Indic languages; sentence-level token sequences and NER tags, with manually labelled test data for eight languages; built by projecting English-side entities over Samanantar alignments
rights_and_attribution: HF card labels CC0 for the packaging and states the source text is not owned by the dataset authors; upstream Samanantar text and source-specific rights must still be reviewed
m3_candidate_use: Candidate proper-name/entity surfaces and multilingual NER regression fixtures; not a canonical person/place/org identity table
admission_blockers: Preserve dataset revision, language, split, sentence ID/row and token span/tag; do not merge same-spelling entities or treat CC0 packaging as clearing source text

resource: Mozilla Common Voice Text Language Identification dataset
data_shape_and_identity: 19M validated sentences from over 300 languages; TSV records include numeric sentence ID, exact language label, source/style and split; release deduplicates by sentence plus language
rights_and_attribution: Mozilla Data Collective dataset page declares CC0-1.0; retain the pinned dataset ID/release and observe its stated usage/privacy conditions
m3_candidate_use: Language-ID and script-aware tokenization regression corpus; can validate precomputed language-selection signals
admission_blockers: The provided label is a dataset language code, not an M3 language/variety identity; preserve row ID and exact label, pin split and avoid treating text as dictionary evidence

resource: DBnary Wiktionary lexical data in OntoLex RDF
data_shape_and_identity: Structured RDF/OntoLex extraction from about 26 Wiktionary language editions; exposes lexical entries, senses and translation-to-sense links; native URIs are dataset/edition scoped
rights_and_attribution: DBnary data page states CC BY-SA 3.0 and derives from Wiktionary; extractor code has a separate license; per-edition text/source rights and attribution remain attached
m3_candidate_use: Schema and data donor for sense-aware dictionary/translation joins; compare with existing Wiktextract source before adapting
admission_blockers: Pin dump/release, language edition and extractor revision; round-trip native entry/sense URIs and translation sense links; do not conflate the code license, data license or Wiktionary text rights

data_shape_and_identity: Token-level NER labels and stable row IDs for 20 African languages; Hugging Face card reports 20 language subsets and AFL 3.0
rights_and_attribution: Pinned dataset card declares AFL 3.0; verify exact repository release, community guidance and source-text rights before redistribution
m3_candidate_use: Low-resource African proper-name surface-form and token-span regression evidence; never infer entity identity from labels
admission_blockers: Preserve language subset, row ID, token sequence and tag sequence; keep same-surface entities distinct; do not generalize data rights from the training-code repository

data_shape_and_identity: CLDF Wordlist reports 319 language varieties, 1,310 concepts, 437,902 lexical records and 85 sources; records are linked to source concept-list IDs and variety identifiers, but 352,262 records are reported without source citations
rights_and_attribution: Derived dataset declares CC BY 4.0; cite Key & Comrie 2023 and the exact DOI release; missing source citation on many rows limits upstream-rights traceability
m3_candidate_use: Cross-variety lexical lookup and concept-based language bridges; keep concept IDs distinct from lexeme/sense identity
admission_blockers: Pin release DOI and file hash; preserve native variety, concept, lexeme and source IDs; do not treat a concept match as exact translation; quarantine records lacking adequate source provenance

data_shape_and_identity: Versioned relational tables exported as CSV, JSON, RData and CLDF; entries carry AUTOTYP language identifiers and bibliography references; feature/value inventories can grow as new phenomena are described
rights_and_attribution: CC BY 4.0 for the released database; cite the exact DOI release and preserve linked bibliographic sources
m3_candidate_use: Language-variety grammar profiles, inflectional/morphosyntactic feature indexes and compact precompute masks
admission_blockers: Pin release 1.1.1 and DOI 10.5281/zenodo.7976754; keep AUTOTYP IDs separate from ISO/Glottolog IDs; retain sparse/unknown states and source links

resource: Atlas of Pidgin and Creole Language Structures (APiCS)
data_shape_and_identity: Versioned CLDF parameter/value/source tables for pidgin and creole structural features; language and feature identifiers are atlas-scoped, not lexeme IDs
rights_and_attribution: Published APiCS dataset declares CC BY 4.0; retain editor/contributor attribution and linked feature sources
m3_candidate_use: Creole-language grammar lookup and regression coverage for sparse typological features
admission_blockers: Pin a released CLDF/Zenodo version; preserve atlas language IDs, parameter IDs, source citations and missing-vs-absent values; not a word dictionary

resource: D-PLACE language, culture and environment database
data_shape_and_identity: Released CLDF records join language identifiers to cultural/environmental variables, geographic data and source citations; feature observations are sparse and source-scoped
rights_and_attribution: Licensing conflict: D-PLACE download page states CC BY-NC 4.0 while its data repository advertises CC-BY-4.0; treat as noncommercial/restricted until the exact release terms are clarified
m3_candidate_use: Discovery and research-only feature crosswalks among language variety, geography and sourced cultural data
admission_blockers: Do not bundle or derive a commercial payload until maintainers resolve the license discrepancy; preserve original source citations and distinct language/ethnographic identifiers

resource: Apertium per-language and bilingual language-data repositories
data_shape_and_identity: Language packs contain monolingual .dix dictionaries, morphological analysis/generation and tagger data; pair packs may include bilingual dictionaries and structural transfer rules; schemas and language-variety coverage are package-specific
rights_and_attribution: Code and data terms must be checked per exact language/pair repository; the apertium-eng example declares GPL-3.0, so no project-wide permissive license is assumed
m3_candidate_use: Evaluate compact finite-state lexicon, inflection and bilingual candidate structures, especially for lower-resource languages
admission_blockers: Pin each repository commit and package; keep code/data licenses distinct; run source analyzer/generator differential tests and preserve package-native lemma, tag and pair IDs before any port

data_shape_and_identity: 2026 release paper reports 17 languages, nearly 5 million tokens, over 250,000 sentences and about 140,000 MWE annotations; corpus/sentence/token IDs and language-specific splits remain release-scoped
rights_and_attribution: No blanket license verified for the complete v2 artifact; prior PARSEME corpus editions use release- and language-specific open licenses, so inspect each current language README and underlying text source
m3_candidate_use: Phrase/idiom candidate lookup, span-aware atomization and multilingual regression fixtures; not a set of exact word-to-word translations
admission_blockers: Do not download or bundle until the v2 artifact, per-language rights, sentence provenance and stable row keys are verified; pin release, preserve token spans/labels/splits, and never flatten an MWE annotation into a lexeme identity
